title: Understanding more while preserving freedom
meaning: Detailed conversation can help you see a wish differently, although a strong need for a particular answer can make that freedom difficult.
text: Understanding a request more deeply and accepting any answer to it are different things. The Empress in the physical position of Vishuddha helps conversation develop: explaining a wish, finding an example and hearing details. The Hanged Man in energy supports readiness to suspend a familiar version and discover another meaning in what is said. The Devil in emotions shows how an expectation can cling. Even after clarification, you may strongly want the particular agreement you hoped for. A new perspective is available in conversation while attachment can move at a different pace.

Suppose you discuss a request to answer every message immediately. Details reveal a wish to stay connected rather than a concern with the exact minute of a reply. **Understanding a wish leaves room for a different answer.** You can discover several ways to show participation and still feel frustrated by a silent phone. That difference between a clear meaning and a strong feeling gives you a real subject to discuss.

The difficulty is using the new explanation as another argument for the original demand. Once the need is better understood, agreement can seem obligatory. Conversation narrows again to a single permissible answer. Acknowledging the strength of your expectation is more honest than presenting it as the only possible condition for closeness, supposedly already shared by both people.
